code_changes.summary: Additive Alembic migration creating ais31_benchmark_runs & ais31_benchmark_results tables
SQLAlchemy models for resumable AIS 3.1 benchmark orchestration and wire provenance
Added exposure breakdown counters & benchmark status fields on CohortProgressCounters and queue items
Fixed Prisma SASE vendor fallback bug via _resolve_cohort_item_vendor and replaced flat exposure flag with _classify_item_exposure
Replaced hardcoded CrowdStrike/Prisma contract lookup with dynamic get_rule_semantics_and_contract
Frozen holdout manifest builder, live /tokenize auditor, sanitized raw_payload fallback extractor, idempotent GPU runner, and statistical evaluator
Hardened leakage denylist to strip FortiSIEM incidentreso/reso keys
Added 6 RBAC-protected AIS 3.1 benchmark & telemetry endpoints
Backend tests for manifest hashing, token budgeting, idempotent resume, RBAC 401/403, Alembic 017, and raw_payload fallback sanitization
Registered tests/ais-3-1-ui-integrity.test.mjs in frontend test script
Added AIS 3.1 typed client methods & exposure/benchmark DTO fields
Removed outdated AIS 2.6e tag from certification tab
Removed AIS 2.7/20-cohort/Priority-5 strings, added dynamic cohort count, vendor/customer filters, separated certification & benchmark progress cards, and admin exposure card
Added AIS 3.1 Provisional vs Certified holdout accuracy comparison card separating Raw LLM vs Validated App metrics
Frontend UI integrity regression assertions for AIS 3.1 changes
